existingReason: typed-generics and callback: PkLookupPicker<TItem> is a thin typed wrapper; Load and Resolve run through PkCallbackSlot, columns come from typed columns, Value and Values bind typed (issue 801 step 8)

params.name: Value
params.note: The key of the chosen item when not Multiple (two-way: @bind-Value; ValueExpression for an EditForm).

params.name: Values
params.note: The keys of the chosen items when Multiple (two-way: @bind-Values; ValuesExpression for an EditForm).

params.name: Config
params.note: Not a parameter: PkLookupPicker<TItem> builds it from Columns, PageSize and AriaLabel.

notes: PkLookupPicker<TItem> (Components/PkLookupPicker.razor) wraps pk-lookup-picker 1:1: Load and Resolve are callback properties, so the component hands the element .NET references (PkCallbackSlot) exactly as PkDataTable does; pk-lookup-select, pk-values-change and pk-lookup-toggle come back as ValueChanged, ValuesChanged and OpenChanged. Keys are strings.
